card.text: LHS 1478 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LHS 1478 b"
sources.quote: LHS 1478 b is a super-Earth exoplanet orbiting around LHS 1478, a red dwarf star located 59.4 light-years from Earth in the constellation of Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around LHS 1478. Its orbit and size follow August et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LHS 1478 b"
sources.quote: It orbits at a distance of 0.018 AU from the star with a inclination of 87° to the plane of the sky.
